item.title: Haggai
item.author: thekingsscribe7@gmail.com (se7en Adeniyi)
item.description:
Build What Matters

📢 Word to 2 officials - Governor & High Priest

The word of the LORD
through Haggai the prophet;

  • to Zerubbabel (son of Shealtiel), governor of Judah, and
  • to Jeshua (son of Jehozadak), the high priest.

This is what the YHVH Sabaoth says:

The people are saying,

Rebuilding the house of the LORD;
Restoration of that which lies in ruins;
can wait.

YHVH’s response through his prophet, Haggai:
He evaluates their thinking
“Should My house yet wait, persist as ruins {these 60+ years};
while you live, content and secure in luxurious homes?”
“Look at the sorry state you’re truly in!” 👇🏽

  • You plant much but harvest little
  • You eat but are not satisfied
  • You drink but are still thirsty
  • You put on clothes but cannot keep warm
  • Your wages are gone: soon as you receive them; as though you’ve got holes for pockets!
    “Take stock of your circumstances! "

Now, Arise! Go up into the mountain, and bring down timber,
and rebuild My house. So that, I may take pleasure in it and be honoured,
says the LORD.

You hoped for rich harvests, but they were poor.
And when you brought your harvest home, I blew it away.
Why? Because My house lies in ruins, says YHVH,
while all of you are busy building your own fine houses.
Abandonment of M633, to seek their own Kingdom & delights

It’s because of you–your dereliction of duty;

  • that the heavens withhold the dew and the earth produces no crops.
  • I have called for a drought on your fields and hills: withering grain and crops; new wine and olive oil; to starve you and your livestock; and to ruin everything you have sought with hard labour.
    In God’s mercy, He topples the Tower of Self-gratification that leads to destruction.

Then Zerubbabel (son of Shealtiel), and Jeshua (son of Jehozadak), the high priest, and the whole remnant of God’s people obeyed the voice of Eternal One, YHVH, their God.

When they heard the words of the prophet Haggai,
whom the LORD their God had sent,
the people revered the LORD.

24.06

📢 Word to Everyone

Then the LORD, by Haggai, His messenger, sent this word to the people:
“I am with you. “

So the LORD stirred up their spirits:

  • Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah
  • Jeshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and
  • the whole remnant of God’s people.

Such that they assembled, and began in earnest, the work on the house of their God:
YHVH, the Eternal, LORD of Stars & Cosmos.

21.07

📢 Word to Everyone

The LORD sent another message through the prophet Haggai.
Ask them,

  • Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah
  • Jeshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and
  • the whole remnant of God’s people there in the land:

Who remembers this House–in its heyday?
All the beauty and splendor, back then?
Now, how does this compare?
Bleak? Drab? Bereft of Glory?
You speak truth.

But now, says YHVH:

Do not despair!
Be strong, Zerubbabel.
Be strong, Jeshua (son of Jehozadak), the high priest.
Be strong, all you people still left in the land.

And now get to work, for I am with you, says the LORD of Cosmos.
My Spirit remains within you,
just as I promised when you came out of Egypt.
So, do not be afraid. '

In just a little while, I will again

  • shake the heavens and the earth;
  • trouble the oceans and the dry land;
  • shake all the nations, and
    the treasures of all the nations will be brought to this Temple.
    I will fill this place with splenour, wealth and glory, says YHVH Sabaoth.
    The silver is Mine, and the gold is Mine, says YHVH.

I promise,

“The Glory of this Restored Temple will surpass the original, " says the Eternal One.
And in this New City, I will usher in, Peace.
I, the LORD of StarGates, have spoken! "

garden 👉🏽 tabernacle/tent 👉🏽 temple/house 👉🏽 city

24.09

1st Message: "Ask the priests"

The LORD of Heaven’s Hosts said to Haggai:
Ask the priests this question about the law.

So, Haggai asked, “If one of you is carrying some meat from a holy sacrifice in his robes and his robe happens to brush against some bread or stew, wine or olive oil, or any other kind of food, will it also become holy? "
The priests replied, “No. "

Then Haggai asked, “What if someone becomes ceremonially unclean by touching a dead person and then touches any of these foods, will the food be defiled? "
And the priests answered, “Yes. "

Then Haggai responded, “That is how it is with this people and this nation, says the LORD. Everything they do and everything they offer is defiled by their sin. "

Consider what unrest you had prior to laying the foundation of El’s Temple.
When you sought to prosper without My Gracious Presence, how did you fare?

When you hoped for a twenty-bushel crop, you harvested only ten.
When you expected to draw fifty gallons from the winepress, you found only twenty.
I sent blight and mildew and hail to destroy everything you sought before Me.
Even so, you refused to return to Me, says the LORD.

Today, as the foundation of this My house is laid,
take stock and give careful consideration to your choices from this point forward.
An invitation to discover futility and prioritise, instead, seeking His Kingdom & Zedek, first!

As it stands now,
There’s no more seed left in the barn:
You haven’t yet harvested your grain, and
Your grapevines, fig trees, pomegranates, and olive trees
have not yet yielded fruit.
But from this day onward, I will bless you. "

2nd Message: to Zerubbabel
On that same day, the word of YHVH came a second time onto Haggai:
“Tell Zerubbabel, the governor of Judah, that

  • I am about to shake the heavens and the earth
  • I will overthrow royal thrones and destroy the power of foreign kingdoms.
  • I will overturn their chariots and riders.
  • The horses will fall, and their riders will kill each other.

“But when this happens, says the LORD of Hosts,

I will honour you, Zerubbabel (son of Shealtiel), My servant.
I’ll take you and wear you like a signet ring, for I have chosen you.
I will be made incorruptible: a gold ring, bearing the name of the LORD.

I, the LORD of Heaven’s Hosts, have spoken! "

Footnotes

names interpreter
Haggai festive
Zerubbabel the seed of Babylon
Shealtiel sought of God
Jeshua Jehovah is his help / Jehovah the Saviour
Jehozadak Jehovah-justified

item.title: Isaiah 58
item.author: thekingsscribe7@gmail.com (se7en Adeniyi)
item.description:
The Fast GOD Chooses

Sound the alarm!
Take a deep breath, and raise your voice, My prophet.
Now’s not the time to pity your vocal chords or save ink!
For this message must ring true: far and wide, like a shofar.
Confront my people with their transgression;
tell the house of Jacob their error.

They keep devotions daily; with services, programs and crusades booked year-round in big halls.
They call ‘seeking Him daily’ a priority and delight to hear the ‘freshest’ preacher, as though {they were} a righteous nation which hath not forsaken the ordinances of their God:
they pre-order in bulk, My Books of Justice Collection;
they love to take selfies near My courts.

Week in, week out, they complain.
“LORD, why have we fasted, and You see it not?”
“Why have we afflicted our souls, and You take no knowledge of it?”

Behold, in the day of your fast you still seek your own profit, and require maximum effort from your workers, driving them hard.

you never give (celebratory) bonuses in My Name; nor let the workers close early

Behold, you fast, not to be penitent of heart (unto repentance);
but only to quarrel and to fight and to strike with a wicked fist.
Fasting like yours this day will not qualify your voice to be heard on high.

Is this My definition of a fast?
A day for a person to afflict his soul?
Is it to bow down his head like a reed, and
to spread sackcloth and ashes under him?

Will you call this a fast, and a day acceptable to the LORD?

“a day acceptable” suggests that God views a “fast” as a day offered as sacrifice unto YHVH.

🔥 Is not this the fast that I have chosen:

  • to loose the bonds of wickedness,
  • to undo the knots of the heavy burdens,
  • to let the oppressed go free, and
  • to break every yoke?

🔥 Is it not to

  • share your bread with the hungry and
  • bring the wandering, homeless poor into your house;
  • cover him, who is naked, and
  • not hide yourself from your own flesh (family)

✅ Then shall

  • your light 🌤️ break forth {out of obscurity, beyond dark clouds} like the dawn, and
  • your healing shall spring up {as a 🌳 tree} speedily;
  • your righteousness {vanguard + herald 🎺} shall go before you;
  • the glory of the LORD shall be your rear guard {🛡️}.

✅ Then you shall

  • call, and the LORD will answer;
  • cry, and He will say, ‘Here I am.’ {For He’ll be walking; keeping step with you, all the way}.

🔥 If you

  • take away the yoke {every form of oppression} from your midst/nation,
  • stop the pointing of the finger {scornful accusations}, and
  • refrain from speaking sinfully {unrighteous judgement | wickedness | vicious slander},

🔥 if you lay down your life for the hungry and
put an end to his misery,

✅ then shall

  • darkness flee before the glory of your new dawn; and
  • the radiance of noonday will be your gloomiest.

✅ And the LORD will

  • guide you continually and
  • keep you unaware of drought in scorched places; by hiding you in His Secret place and
  • make your bones nutrient-dense like GOD-Ore;
  • and you will flourish like a watered garden, like a spring of the deep, whose waters do not fail.

✅ And

  • your ancient ruins shall be rebuilt;
  • you shall raise up the foundations of many generations;
  • you shall be called the Repairer of the Breach, the Restorer of Pathways to Secret Realm(s).

🔥 If you turn back

  • your foot from trampling My Sabbath Protocols,
  • from doing your pleasure on My holy day,
  • and call {esteem} the Sabbath a delight, looking forward to it; and the holy day of the LORD honorable;

🔥 if you honour the LORD,
not going your own ways, or seeking your own pleasure, or speaking your own words; but

acknowledging Him in all your ways;
finding pleasure in His judgements;
seeking first, His Kingdom and Zedek with every word from your lips…

✅ then you shall find yourself fully satisfied in your epignosis of Yahweh,
and I will

  • make you ride upon the high places of the earth;
  • feed you with the heritage of Jacob your father,

for the mouth of the LORD has spoken.

item.title: Opened Ear
item.author: thekingsscribe7@gmail.com (se7en Adeniyi)
item.description:
A brief account of scribe 7's experience of the Word that came through Isaiah (50:5)

[03-13-13] “Send. “ | Isaiah 50v5

The LORD GOD has opened My ear [unto His preferred wavelength]
And I have not been rebellious [to insist on attuning my ear to the common air]
Nor have I turned back [from His counsel / commandment]

It is none but the LORD GOD, who has opened My ear.
Why HE?!

YHVH. Sovereign GOD.
What is the meaning of Your NAME?
Reveal, NOW, Yourself to me.

Who is YHVH?
That I should know?
That it may be clear to my Soul,
why I am called.
Why My ears are opened.

Yod - Hei - Vav - Hei

Y - Beginning-Ending. Faithful and True.
H - Ruach/Breath
V - Presence + Unity
H - Ruach

Called!
That as embodiment of Yod {Beginning-Ending},
I should breathe out—River of Water of LIFE (which is as air)
as I am the joining of Quasar and Earth realms:
GOD and Man.
El’s breath: Sovereign El “breathes Me. "

As Yod-Vav;
GOD and Man;
Father and Son;
Exchange Breath.

In comes GLORY,
out flows LIFE.
